summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR shareholding transaction: Maya Martinez-Davis, President US, acquired 9.293 notional American Depositary Shares at $51.38 each via her GSK Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on May 22, 2026. This is a routine insider trading notification for a de minimis amount, not a corporate special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant is merely fulfilling its foreign private issuer reporting obligation.
